-- Filter districts within 25 km of Erode

    SELECT 
        id,
        names."primary" AS name,
        subtype,
        region,
        ST_Distance(
            ST_MakePoint(ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry), 0, 0),

        ST_MakePoint(ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry), 0, 0),
        ST_MakePoint(ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry), 0, 0)
    ) < 25
)

    id,
    name
FROM 
    districts
ORDER BY 
    distance_km;
